    AI Overview
    Yes, U.S. Postal Service (USPS) locations are
    open and operating normally on Good Friday    . Because Good Friday is not a federal holiday, mail will be delivered as usual, and all post offices will have regular operating hours. 
    Key Details for Good Friday: 
    • Mail Delivery: Regular mail and packages will be delivered by USPS.
    • Post Office Locations: Offices are open; you can use the USPS Locations tool to verify local hours.
    • Other Services: UPS and FedEx are also operating normally.
    • Banks/Stock Market:
      While many banks are open, some may have adjusted hours; however, U.S. stock markets are closed.
       
    Post offices are generally closed on Easter Sunday, which is two days after Good Friday.

    People also ask
    Does U.S. mail run on Good Friday?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Yes, the U.S. Postal Service (USPS) operates on normal schedules on Good Friday
    . Post offices are open, and mail is delivered as usual because it is not a federal holiday. Other major carriers, including UPS and FedEx, also operate on Good Friday, though FedEx may have modified service. 
    • USPS: Regular delivery and mail services continue.
    • UPS: Delivering and open.
    • FedEx: Operating with some modified services.
    • Banks/Businesses: Most are open, though they may have limited hours.
    • Stock Market: The New York Stock Exchange and Nasdaq are closed. 
    Note: There is no mail delivery on Sunday, Easter Sunday.
